text: Will drives with his girlfriend Kira to his former home in the Hollywood Hills, where his ex-wife Eden and her new husband David are hosting a dinner party for old friends. Eden met David at a grief support group in Mexico after [the accidental death of her and Will's young son|wrong|loss that won't heal], and now the couple speak warmly of [a cult-like group called The Invitation|origin|grief that will not end]. David locks the front door, and Will, [reliving memories in every room|who_suffers|the grieving], watches uneasily as [drinks are poured for a toast|images|food, drink and drugs].
